correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the directed-path face predicate as at most one selected incoming/outgoing arc per vertex and no directed cycle. Independent exhaustive enumeration of all subsets up to seven arcs (an eight-vertex acyclic path forest cannot have more) reproduced the face vector (20,154,560,976,720,144). The stated toggle sequence gives 1269 matching pairs; independent topological sorting of all oriented Hasse incidences verified acyclicity. It leaves one critical 0-cell, five 3-cells and thirty 4-cells with the listed masks. Independent signed gradient elimination reproduced the entire 5x30 matrix. Its columns generate u and 2v where u=(-1,0,0,1,0) and v=(0,1,-1,0,1); the span of u,v is saturated since their first two rows have a unit minor. Thus Smith factors are (1,2). Full simplicial boundary ranks independently give reduced Betti (4,29) in degrees (3,4) over F2 and (3,28) over F3, F5 and F7. Homotopy is stronger than the field checks: the Morse 3-skeleton is a wedge of five 3-spheres, Hurewicz identifies attaching maps with their degrees, and unimodular row and column operations are realized by self-equivalences of target and attaching sphere wedges before taking the homotopy cofiber. The unit cofiber is contractible and the degree-two one gives the stated Moore space, leaving three S^3 and twenty-eight S^4.
